searchLog: 16th consecutive day of the same network-egress failure (logged 2026-09-22 through 2026-10-05, now 2026-10-06 too). Independently re-verified before giving up, same as yesterday's run: WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for job-boards.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, www.databricks.com, and jobs.lever.co -- and this run went further and also tried a completely unrelated, non-job domain (en.wikipedia.org) to test whether the block is job-board-specific or a blanket allowlist. It too returned EGRESS_BLOCKED. The only URL WebFetch could load at all was the bare https://www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs root, which confirmed what target-companies.json's note already says: Anthropic has no new-grad pipeline (55 Applied AI / pre-sales reqs, all senior; 24 TPM reqs, all mid/senior; Fellows Program is research-track and out of scope per profile.md's 6 target role families). WebSearch still works normally and was used once (Anthropic Applied AI Architect) but per the hunt's own verification rule a search snippet or aggregator listing is never sufficient to include an opportunity -- only a fetched, confirmed application page qualifies -- so nothing from search results was added. This is conclusively an environment network-policy restriction scoped to this scheduled routine's WebFetch tool (not a transient outage, not specific to job boards, not fixable by retrying or searching differently): it has now blocked every one of ~29 target-companies.json boards and every fellowship/accelerator domain tried across 16 straight days. Zero verified opportunities is the correct and honest output. This needs a human to widen the WebFetch egress allowlist for the life-hub-daily hunt routine to cover standard job-board domains (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable) and company career/program sites -- re-running the hunt again tomorrow will not fix it.
